findings.source_evidence: The source defines a substantive fractional-step finite-volume algorithm on rectangular or logically rectangular grids and retains cases requiring a fully multidimensional method.

rationale: Although the right-hand checklist mirrors much of the source vocabulary, the theorem only unfolds its definition and all decisive numerical meanings are opaque user-supplied predicates. It is therefore strictly weaker.
